clips.title: The story
paras: At Sun Rock Retreat, Maggran Earthbinder seeks Bloodfury Ripper's Remains as proof that the Bloodfury harpy leader is dead. Her death strikes at the threat to the tauren settlement.

Bloodfury Ripper leads the harpies of the Charred Vale with fierce, territorial aggression. They nest among the scorched ruins and threaten travelers and shamans across the Stonetalon Mountains. Culling the flock eases the danger for a time, but Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat knows that lasting relief means removing its leader. Bloodfury Ripper rules almost like a queen, directing the harpies' attacks on their territory. Her remains prove she is dead, leaving the flock in disarray and giving the tauren who seek to heal and secure their rugged lands greater peace of mind.
